pages.ld_description: Torben Kuhlmann's amazing book Armstrong,The Adventurous Journey of a Mouse to the Moon transports the readers to the moon and beyond. Armstrong is a sweeping and ambitious picture book that is poised to become one of the classroom favorites. Young and old readers alike will easily identify with Armstrong’s successes, failures, and quick resolve. They will marvel at his ingenuity, and they will learn from the way he breaks down the gigantic task of getting to the moon into minute steps that just may convince them that anything is possible if they put their mind to it.
